answer: A kernel of per-task receipts records who did what, and the fable of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
